column5: Phase 3 VTE thromboprophylaxis after total knee arthroplasty against apixaban and enoxaparin (n=2,000), a real second indication refused as a layer on two grounds. Uptake: the seed's own refusal stands, since every anticoagulant launched into this use (Xarelto, Eliquis) files one CMS Part D line across AF, VTE treatment and post-arthroplasty prophylaxis, so no capture of the post-surgical pool can be measured. Engine: a pipeline asset carries one annual price and one discontinuation for every indication, so a short post-operative course would be charged the AF price (CMS Part D $4,706 a beneficiary-year) and carried at 78.7% persistence, which no cited figure supports

Phase 3 VTE thromboprophylaxis after total knee arthroplasty against aspirin (n=2,000), the sister study of NCT07015905 and refused on the same two grounds: no CMS line separates post-arthroplasty use from AF, and a pipeline asset prices every indication at one annual price and one persistence. Were a layer built, this readout would follow NCT07015905 on the same pool and decide nothing further

IZABRIGHT-Breast01, Phase 2/3 against chemotherapy in first-line metastatic TNBC not eligible for anti-PD-(L)1 (n=600), a real second indication refused as a layer, confirming the seed's filed refusal. Pool: SEER gives TNBC incidence (the 34,695 the Trodelvy row carries) but no free US source counts the patients who reach first-line metastatic treatment ineligible for anti-PD-(L)1. Uptake: the two products labelled in this line, Trodelvy and Datroway, each file one CMS Part B line across all their breast and lung indications, so no first-line capture can be measured

Phase 2 in bipolar I or II depression on a mood stabiliser (n=195), confirming the seed's filed refusal. The pool is citable (data/epidemiology.csv, Bipolar Disorder 3,776,689, NIMH) but the uptake is not: every recent branded launch in bipolar depression (Caplyta, Vraylar, Latuda) files one revenue and CMS line across schizophrenia, bipolar and MDD. Were it modelled, the MDD Phase 2 NCT07276997 (2027-09) would still decide the asset's gate first

Phase 2b/3 suprachoroidal sura-vec in diabetic retinopathy without centre-involved DME (n=576), a real second indication refused as a layer: no free source measures the uptake of any therapy in non-proliferative DR without CI-DME, because Eylea's NPDR claim shares one CMS Part B line (aflibercept) with wet AMD, DME and RVO. The seed's note that DR sits on a separate record, asset 1651, is stale: no asset 1651 exists and every DR study of the molecule is on this one

The registry's official title is 'A Phase 1b Dose Escalation and Expansion Study of IMGN151 as Monotherapy and in Combination With Other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Subjects With Gynecologic Cancers'; all six arms (A to F) give IMGN151, alone or with carboplatin, olaparib or bevacizumab, and the primary outcome is dose-limiting toxicities. It decides a dose and a partner, not whether a patient gets the drug, and its disease is the ovarian, fallopian tube and peritoneal cancer the book already values on Ovarian Neoplasms

CRYSTAL-1 is a Phase 2a with three separately filed cohorts (Narcolepsy Type 1, Narcolepsy Type 2, Idiopathic Hypersomnia), each ORX750 against placebo, and its primary outcome is treatment-emergent adverse events. The asset's gate is the Phase 2/3 SAPPHIRE (NCT07598708, 2027-09-30), and the seed states idiopathic hypersomnia is inside the narcolepsy forecast already

Phase 3 safety and immunogenicity of a single dose of PCV21 against 20vPCV in 100 children and adolescents aged 2 to 17 with sickle cell disease; the primary outcome is immediate adverse events. Sickle cell disease is the risk condition, not the indication: the vaccine prevents pneumococcal disease, the indication the book values, and the seed already names this study a high-risk subgroup of the same paediatric pool
